name: pepe-multi-channel-content-pipelines
description: Designing, running, and optimising autonomous multi-channel content pipelines: Veo character generation, Instagram reels, X cross-posting, blog publishing, and the editorial calendar that ties them together. Each skill has a setup command that walks the human operator through external dependencies (Google AI Studio, Meta Business, X Developer Platform, Cloudflare Pages) and multiple procedural commands the agent runs autonomously. Designed to fully replicate Pepe Arturo's content pipeline on any brand.
